purpose: Before SC1-1a: measure the region false-alarm risk of the pinned score line and tau on films that are neither taught on nor SC1-1a films (owner ruling 5 Nov 2026, 'Check first'; Task 10 review, Risks A and B). Information plus one decision rule; it changes no threshold.

films.ceph400Train: Ceph-400 split 'train' of splits.json: films 001-150 (tools/dataset/prepare_ceph400.py: n <= 150), 150 films, at 0.1 mm/px, with their expert tracings (the 19 points). Every id must be three digits in 001-150, else refused before any film is read. Never taught to the region finder (spec §4.2: no Ceph-400 film is used; --sc1-teaching-boxes reads Aariz train only). Not an SC1-1a film (SC1-1a's normal films are Ceph-400 test1 151-300 and Aariz valid). These tracings are in the shape reference set, so the shape look is not run here.
films.holdout: The 70 Aariz-train hold-out films of reference/sc1-aariz-split.json (never taught on), with their traced 19 points only (the extra teaching points are never checked). Information: it shows how far inside tau the clean films sit.
films.refused: Ceph-400 test2, Aariz test, Ceph-400 test1 and Aariz valid (and 'all'), before any file is read. The probe never reads SC1-1a's films and never prints a flag rate for them.

detector: models/regions (manifest kind regions, ONNX Runtime CPU fp32), fingerprint 17171e68f9f7072062e2a3a2cbd4851618056f5136bed998f1782c49d4897b80; else broken

calibration.file: models/regions/calibration.json exactly as Task 10 wrote it (region-calibration/1), read with ceph_model::wholefilm::parse_calibration
calibration.requires: the calibration's detector fingerprint is the one above and its gateReportSha256 is the value above; reports/sc1/box-gate.json exists, its SHA-256 is that value and its verdict is pass; else broken
calibration.unchanged: the calibration file must hold exactly this score line and these tau; the probe changes neither

measured.path: the app's own region path: the detector's best box per region (sc1_boxes::boxes_for, cached per fingerprint), Regions::from_scored at the calibration's score line, then ceph_model::wholefilm::check_film with no shape scorer (shape not set up), the film's recorded facing (right: Ceph-400's tracings are checked to face right when the dataset is prepared; the Aariz films are taken as stored, facing right), the film's width and height, and the calibration's tau
perFilm: per region: the largest outside-ratio of its traced points (distance outside the detected box / the box's longer side; 0 inside), null when the region is not found

per region: the largest signed edge-ratio of its traced points (outside: +outside-ratio; inside: -(distance to the nearest edge) / the box's longer side), null when not found; information, it shows how far inside the edge the worst point sits
per region: whether any traced point's outside-ratio is above tau_r
per region: whether check_film gives a region flag for it (a point above tau_r, or a point off the film)
no-ceph-found (fewer than 3 of 5 regions found; check_film's MIN_REGIONS_FOUND)
facing: whether check_film gives a facing flag (the detector's facing from the soft-tissue and cranial-base boxes, against the recorded facing)
flagged by the region rules: check_film flags the film for any reason (region, no-ceph-found or facing; no shape look is run)

reported.perSetAndRegion: films, not found, films with a point above tau_r, films with a region flag, and the outside-ratio and signed edge-ratio median, p90, p99 and max over the films that found the region (nearest rank: the ceil(q n)-th smallest value); null when no film found the region
reported.perSet: films; regions-found counts (5, 4, 3, fewer than 3); no-ceph-found; facing flags; films flagged by the region rules, as a count and as a percentage of the set

decision.rule: Ceph-400 Train: films flagged by the region rules <= 3 of 150 (<= 2%, the SC1-1a normal-film rate of 6 of 300) -> keep tau as is and proceed to SC1-1a. More than 3 -> stop; to the owner with options; tau unchanged by this probe.
decision.holdout: information only; it never changes the decision

controls.positive: the same 150 Ceph-400 Train films with the mandible's five traced points (Go, Me, Pog, B, Gn) moved 40 mm (400 px at 0.1 mm/px) forward, +x (spec §9.1 C3), judged against the same boxes: flagged by the region rules on at least 140 of 150, else the probe is blind (exit 1)
controls.counts: each set's film count equals its total (150 and 70) and every region's count (found + not found) equals it; else broken (exit 1)
controls.refusals: the refused sets above are refused before any file is read; a test plants each and watches the refusal
controls.committed: this file committed as built (git show HEAD), from a clean tree; else broken (exit 1)

exits.0: Ceph-400 Train flagged <= 3 of 150 and the controls hold: keep tau, proceed to SC1-1a
exits.3: flagged > 3 of 150 and the controls hold: stop, to the owner
exits.1: broken: a control fails, a count is off, a refused set was asked for, or the detector, calibration or gate report is not the pinned one; nothing concluded
